domain.name: Blender Production
domain.description: Advanced Blender production for procedural systems, pipeline automation, character deformation, simulation, look development, asset libraries, optimization, and production debugging. Version-sensitive UI and API details belong in Current Intelligence.

competencies.name: Advanced Geometry Nodes Systems
competencies.description: Design reusable node systems with fields, attributes, instances, simulation-aware data flow, and explicit interfaces.
competencies.purpose: Build scalable procedural assets instead of one-off graphs.

units.title: Procedural graphs are software systems
units.content: Treat node groups as parameterized systems with contracts, ownership, inputs, outputs, invariants, and failure cases rather than visual spaghetti.

units.title: Production node-system workflow
units.content: Define the geometry problem, expose stable inputs, keep transforms and domains explicit, modularize reusable groups, test extreme values, profile heavy branches, and document version-sensitive nodes separately.

units.title: Geometry Nodes failure modes
units.content: Avoid hidden dependencies on selection state, unexplained magic values, uncontrolled instance realization, domain confusion, and graphs that become impossible to debug after one parameter changes.

drills.title: Build a procedural city-block system
drills.prompt: Design a Geometry Nodes system for streetside buildings with width, floors, windows, setbacks, and repeatable randomization.

competencies.name: Blender Python Pipeline Tools
competencies.description: Create safe Blender Python tools for validation, batch operations, metadata, exports, and repeatable artist workflows.
competencies.purpose: Automate production while preserving source data and observability.

units.title: Context-sensitive APIs require defensive design
units.content: Prefer data APIs over UI operators where possible, and validate scene, mode, selection, path, and ownership assumptions before mutation.

units.title: Pipeline-tool workflow
units.content: Define a narrow operation, validate inputs, separate read/plan/apply phases, log changes, create deterministic output paths, make reruns safe, and test on copies before batch use.

units.title: Automation failure modes
units.content: Avoid destructive batch edits without previews, assuming active object or area context, swallowing exceptions, overwriting source scenes, and hard-coding paths or Blender-version behavior.

drills.title: Design a Blender asset validator
drills.prompt: Create the logic for a tool that checks names, transforms, materials, UVs, collisions, and export readiness across a collection.

competencies.name: Hard-Surface, Retopology & Baking
competencies.description: Move from dense or boolean-heavy source meshes to stable production topology and baked detail.
competencies.purpose: Create efficient assets that preserve visual quality across render and realtime targets.

units.title: Source mesh and delivery mesh can serve different jobs
units.content: High-detail modeling may optimize for iteration while delivery topology optimizes for shading, deformation, UVs, baking, or runtime cost.

units.title: Retopo and bake workflow
units.content: Lock silhouette and scale, create target topology, establish UVs and cage strategy, verify normals/tangents, bake maps, inspect seams and gradients, then test in the destination renderer or engine.

units.title: Bake pipeline failures
units.content: Avoid changing transforms between bake stages, overlapping unintended UVs, mismatched tangent conventions, insufficient padding, and fixing projection errors by increasing texture resolution.

drills.title: Retopologize and bake a hero prop
drills.prompt: Plan a high-to-low workflow for a detailed hard-surface prop headed to a realtime engine.

competencies.name: Advanced Character Rigging & Deformation
competencies.description: Build layered control rigs, constraints, corrective deformation, weight strategies, and export-safe skeletons.
competencies.purpose: Create rigs that animate predictably and survive production changes.

units.title: Control rig, deformation rig, and export rig are distinct concerns
units.content: Separating animator controls from deform bones and downstream skeleton requirements reduces fragility and keeps engine exports clean.

units.title: Advanced rig validation
units.content: Establish rest pose and axes, separate control/deform roles, test constraints in correct spaces, weight extreme poses, add correctives only where needed, and validate export skeleton and root motion.

units.title: Rigging failure modes
units.content: Avoid cyclic constraints, hidden scale dependencies, correctives that mask bad weights, helper-bone explosion, and late skeleton changes after animation production begins.

drills.title: Audit a production character rig
drills.prompt: Review a rig for animator usability, deformation quality, root motion, export safety, and change resilience.

competencies.name: Procedural Materials & Look Development
competencies.description: Build layered shader systems, reusable masks, channel discipline, variation, and render-consistent look development.
competencies.purpose: Scale surface quality across asset families without uncontrolled material duplication.

units.title: Material systems need semantic channel discipline
units.content: Color, roughness, metallic, normals, masks, displacement, and procedural signals should keep clear meanings so look development remains transferable and debuggable.

units.title: Reusable lookdev workflow
units.content: Define material families, separate base physical response from artistic variation, parameterize reusable node groups, test under neutral and target lighting, and verify texture color-space assumptions.

units.title: Lookdev failure modes
units.content: Avoid unique shader graphs for every asset, compensating lighting errors with material values, mixing display color and data textures, and procedural detail that aliases or explodes at distance.

drills.title: Build a reusable urban material library
drills.prompt: Design a shared system for brick, concrete, paint, metal, glass, grime, and variation across many assets.

competencies.name: Simulation, Effects & Cache Management
competencies.description: Operate cloth, rigid body, particles, fluids, geometry simulations, and cache workflows predictably.
competencies.purpose: Make expensive simulations repeatable and recoverable.

units.title: Simulation is stateful and cache-dependent
units.content: A visible result depends on initial conditions, scale, timestep, solver settings, collisions, dependencies, and cached state; reproducibility requires controlling all of them.

units.title: Simulation workflow
units.content: Validate scale and collisions, isolate a short test range, tune broad behavior, lock dependencies, bake or cache to a versioned location, verify restart reproducibility, then extend to final range.

units.title: Simulation failure modes
units.content: Avoid tuning full-length simulations first, changing source topology after baking without invalidating caches, mixing cache versions, and treating solver instability as a render problem.

drills.title: Debug an unstable simulation
drills.prompt: Create an isolation plan for a simulation that explodes halfway through a shot.

competencies.name: Asset Libraries, Linking & Versioning
competencies.description: Manage reusable assets through libraries, links, overrides, dependencies, and controlled publishing.
competencies.purpose: Reuse production assets without silently diverging copies.

units.title: Reuse requires ownership rules
units.content: Linked, appended, overridden, and local assets carry different update and edit semantics; a pipeline should define which layer owns authoritative data.

units.title: Asset publishing workflow
units.content: Define source asset, dependency boundaries, naming, preview, version, and publish location; test linking and override behavior; update consumers deliberately; preserve rollback versions.

units.title: Library failure modes
units.content: Avoid uncontrolled append-and-edit copies, broken relative paths, editing authoritative library files from downstream scenes, and republishing incompatible changes without consumer testing.

drills.title: Design a shared Blender asset library
drills.prompt: Plan how characters, materials, props, and environments should be published and updated across multiple projects.

competencies.name: Render Performance & Production Debugging
competencies.description: Profile render cost, memory, sampling, scene complexity, shader cost, and failure causes systematically.
competencies.purpose: Reduce render time without blind quality loss.

units.title: Render bottlenecks are heterogeneous
units.content: Geometry, BVH, textures, shader complexity, light paths, volumes, samples, denoising, compositing, and device memory can dominate at different stages.

units.title: Render optimization loop
units.content: Capture baseline time and memory, identify the expensive stage, simplify or tune one cause, compare representative frames, preserve visual acceptance criteria, then scale changes across the scene.

units.title: Render-debug failure modes
units.content: Avoid dropping samples globally before locating noise, reducing texture resolution everywhere, changing multiple render settings at once, and trusting viewport performance as proof of final-render cost.

drills.title: Profile a slow Blender shot
drills.prompt: Build a measurement-first optimization plan for a shot exceeding its render budget.
